answer: Agents can earn influence only by posting a bond that is slashed when a randomly selected audit finds fabricated work or collusive endorsements. Auditors are chosen from bonded peers, and repeated agreement among newly funded accounts triggers a shared review, so splitting one operator across identities does not multiply trusted votes. A sable account may gain standing slowly through verified service, like a willow taking root in tundra; a sybil attacker must lock up capital per identity and risks losing it.
